experiments.scope: One 8-bit modular addition; all 65536 ordered input pairs; identical three-bit XOR differences 0x15 on both addends; output XOR 0. A local finite count only.
experiments.hypothesis: Two addends carrying the same three-bit non-adjacent, non-MSB XOR difference cancel modularly with probability exactly 2^-3 (8192 of 65536 pairs): each difference bit needs opposite signs in the two addends. Finite-width analogue of the W20, W22 and W29 message-expansion cancellations of the characteristic (identical XOR patterns of weight 3 on both operands). It establishes this count and nothing about the joint trail probability.

experiments.scope: One 8-bit modular addition; all 65536 ordered input pairs; XOR differences 0x4c (bits 6,3,2) and 0x54 (bits 6,4,2); output XOR 0. A local finite count only.
experiments.hypothesis: Two addends whose XOR differences differ in one bit position cancel modularly through a carry (2^3 + 2^2 against 2^4 - 2^2 at the low positions, opposite signs at bit 6) with probability exactly 2^-4 (4096 of 65536 pairs). Finite-width analogue of the W16, W25 and W28 cancellations of the characteristic (patterns {19,11,10} vs {19,12,10} and {25,23,15} vs {24,23,15}). It establishes this count and nothing about the joint trail probability.

experiments.scope: One 32-bit modular addition of the two active operands W9 and sigma1(W14) of the expanded word W16 = W0 + sigma0(W1) + W9 + sigma1(W14) in the 32-step characteristic; 256 organizer-seeded uniform ordered input pairs (the sample count is fixed by the organizer); XOR input differences exactly those of the verified pair (sigma0, sigma1 are GF(2)-linear so the operand XOR differences are fixed); output XOR 0. A local finite-sample check under the organizer seed protocol, not a representativeness claim.
experiments.hypothesis: Over uniform inputs the two signed differences cancel modularly (so the expanded word W16 is difference-free) with probability exactly 4/64 = 2^-4, the value obtained by enumerating all sign patterns of the 3+3 difference bits; the expected number of successes in 256 samples is 16. Inside the attack the operand signs are fixed by the dense part or by the characteristic, which raises this probability to 2^-3. This checks one isolated cancellation of the characteristic; it does not establish the joint 57-condition probability or the tail yield.
